title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.158 QA: replaces the open Conditions and Initiative Biography panels with a compact status bar directly below the sheet tabs. Conditions and Critical Injuries now use separate icons, live count badges, and click-open dropdowns; Initiative sits alongside them with Cool/Vigilance and Roll Initiative, while GM encounter controls remain tucked into a compact GM menu. Biography and Backstory now use the full content width below the status bar. Preserves the portrait-first XP/Funds header, two-row Characteristics and Health & Defense snapshot, five-pip Skills, Talent Tier lanes, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
